claim: AI native consumer lending platform for underserved Americans
AI native consumer lending platform for underserved Americans. Founded in 2024 by Jeanot Dawson, Oliver Lambson, and Hugo Markland, Karoo has 3 employees based in Toronto, ON, Canada.
Jeanot Dawson, Founder/CEO: CEO of Karoo, previously Head of US Loans at Lendable
Hugo Markland, Founder: Chief Capital Officer of Karoo Early stage employee at Lendable and led UK capital markets - raised bns of funding
Oliver Lambson, Founder/CTO: CTO of Karoo. 0 lines of code to first loan in 45 days.
Website description: Personal loans from $500 to $5000. Get approved in seconds, and your money in hours. Fully-online: no phone calls, no branch visits, no extra fees.
